text:
The best all-round pick I found is the Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand with Qi2 25W. If you mostly want a cheaper charger for your nightstand, the ESR CryoBoost is the alternative.

I couldn't open the full WIRED roundup. The page was too large for me to read, so I'm not drawing on its rankings. This is based on Macworld's Satechi review (April 2026) and the ESR product page.

**Best overall: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand (Qi2 25W), $129.99**
- Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It lifts the iPhone more than 70 mm, and the pad tilts through 160°, so it works well as a desk stand for FaceTime or a visible screen.
- It charges the iPhone at up to 25 W (Qi2.2). The Apple Watch module and the AirPods pad are each rated 5 W, and the Watch charges fast.
- A 45W power adapter and a 4-foot cable come in the box. The adapter also includes UK and EU plugs.
- It folds to 152 × 90 × 30 mm. It weighs 399 g, which is more than twice the 148 g of the Kuxiu and ESR folding stands.
- Buy: [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V?tag=macworld05-20&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1), [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w), [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW) or [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html)

**Best for a nightstand with cooling: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25 W), $99.99**
- It has an active cooling fan, so it can keep the iPhone at the full 25 W rate. It includes a 50 W adapter.
- The 25 W rate only applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20 W, and older iPhones get 15 W.
- ESR doesn't publish the stand's dimensions.
- ESR's US store accepts the code PARTNER18 for $17.99 off, which brings it to about $82. Dealectric tested it in the cart on Oct 23, and it expires Dec 31, 2026. Check the final price at checkout.
- Buy: [ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- A 15 W version of the same stand costs $79.99 if you don't need 25 W.

**Other options Macworld mentions**
- **Kuxiu X40 Turbo ($79.99):** the most compact folding 25 W stand, but it only lifts the iPhone about 35 mm.
- **Belkin UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 and Anker Prime 3-in-1 MagGo:** fast 25 W stands that Macworld recommends, but they aren't meant for travel.
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 3-in-1 25W:** a newer model with a cooling fan. Macworld reviewed it on Oct 13, but I didn't read that review.

**Which to choose**
- For a desk setup, or if you want the best viewing angle, get the Satechi.
- For a bedside charger at a lower price, get the ESR, especially with the code.
- For frequent travel, the Kuxiu X40 is lighter and smaller than the Satechi.
